name: eq2d_equilibrium
note: Same PhreeqcRM setup and react() call as a PhreeqcRM-based coupling (phreeqc.dat, mol/L, pe 4, porosity 0.3, SetConcentrations replaces only Ca, C, Cl, Mg; H, O and minerals stay in the cell). Cells evolve; each step mimics transport by mixing totals. One independent chain of n_cells cells per inlet_fraction_max value; rows = chains x n_cells x n_steps.
